mentions.name: Slay
mentions.description: A GUI framework for Go that uses a flexbox-like layout system to render UIs for desktop apps in pure Go, without using HTML, JS, or CSS. Built as part of the Sprouts project.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Part of making this project involves creating a GUI framework for Go

https://judi.systems/slay/

Using flexbox-like layout system, it can render UIs for desktop apps in pure go (without using html/js/css).
